api_params.name: base_year
api_params.description: Select the Base Year (2011-12 supports Current & Back series, 2022-23 supports Current only)

api_params.name: series
api_params.description:
Select the Series type.
- If base_year = 2011-12 → Allowed values: Current, Back
- If base_year = 2022-23 → Allowed value: Current only

api_params.name: indicator_code
api_params.description:
Enter the Indicator code(s). Comma separated for multiple values.
- Codes 1–22: National-level indicators (e.g. GDP, GVA, PFCE) — no state_code needed. Comma separated for multiple values
- Codes 23–34: State-level indicators (e.g. GSDP, NSDP, GSVA) — requires state_code. Comma separated for multiple values

api_params.name: quarterly_code
api_params.description: Enter the Quarterly code (from 1 to 4. Comma separated for multiple values)

api_params.name: state_code
api_params.description: Enter the State code (from 01 to 37. Comma separated for multiple values)

api_params.name: year
api_params.description: Enter the Year (format YYYY-YY. Comma separated for multiple values)

api_params.name: approach_code
api_params.description: Enter the Approach code (from 01 to 03. Comma separated for multiple values)

api_params.name: revision_code
api_params.description: Enter the Revision code (from 01 to 07. Comma separated for multiple values)

api_params.name: account_code
api_params.description: Enter the Account code (from 01 to 02. Comma separated for multiple values)

api_params.name: institutional_code
api_params.description: Enter the Institutional code (from 01 to 11. Comma separated for multiple values)

api_params.name: industry_code
api_params.description: Enter the Industry code (from 01 to 17. Comma separated for multiple values)

api_params.name: subindustry_code
api_params.description: Enter the Subindustry code (from 01 to 18. Comma separated for multiple values)

api_params.name: page
api_params.description: Enter the page no. (from 1 to n.)

parameter_notes: base_year='2011-12' supports series Current and Back; base_year='2022-23' supports Current only. indicator_code accepts comma-separated values in get_data (1-34). Codes 1-22 are national-level; 23-34 are state-level and require state_code. New filter: account_code (01-02) for applicable indicators. Filter metadata API uses frequency_code 1=Annually, 2=Quarterly; get_data accepts 'Annually'/'Quarterly' (or 1/2).
